prompt:
Create a native high fidelity illustrated fighting-game sprite atlas of SKULL FACE, exact original Metal Gear Solid V: The Phantom Pain (2015) incarnation, from the supplied original PS4 game captures and official PlayStation portrait. This is a living scarred human antagonist wearing formal clothing, NOT a skeleton, not a masked zombie, not a Skulls soldier, not Ground Zeroes variant. Native transparent RGBA PNG with no background. EXACTLY TWELVE entirely separate complete full-body figures in a FOUR COLUMN by THREE ROW evenly spaced grid, reading left-to-right top-to-bottom. Prefer landscape 1536 x 1024. All figures wholly within cell with 40px empty alpha separation and 30px at outer edges. Fixed orthographic side/three-quarter fighting-game projection and constant standing body scale. Detailed clean hand-painted 2D game art, restrained neutral source materials. No text, cell lines, scenery, shadows, glow, smoke, auras, detached hats, blood pools, skull-monster teeth or extra people.

IDENTITY: pale grey-beige scarred burnt HUMAN face and neck, two living eyes, dark black leather DOMINO mask over both eyes with thin straps at temples, actual intact human jaw/lips/nose, NO exposed bones or skull. Black broad-brim fedora with creased crown and narrow black band stays firmly on head in all12poses. The source formal outfit is a fitted CHARCOAL/BLACK single-breasted tailored long coat with lapels and thigh-length hem (not ankle-length cloak), matching dark waistcoat, grey-beige collared shirt and narrow black tie. Small subdued original gold XOF crest/badge on ANATOMICAL LEFT breast of waistcoat only when that side visible; never Diamond Dogs diamond. Black leather FULL gloves both hands. Dark loosely tailored trousers tucked into tall BLACK WESTERN/RIDING BOOTS just below knees, restrained original diagonal stitching across shafts and textured pointed-ish toe, small heel (not bulky modern combat boot laces). No armor, no military pouches, no backpack, no holstered pistol invented. Keep source mid-thigh coat rear split and attached hems; not huge flapping cape. Source episodes show unarmed dialogue walking and gestures: these sheets use empty gloved hands, no firearm or grenade is drawn, no combat ability is claimed canonical. Undercoating scene is dark; render neutral charcoal textures readable without tinting costume blue/green. All 12 figures must face SCREEN LEFT, including crouch/jump/KO. Independently authored anatomical view, NEVER merely flip right-side art to opposite side.

Sheet B exact twelve authored physical combat poses (adapted versus normals, NOT source-extracted combat): Row1 0 light jab preparation closed gloved fist near chest; 1 active straight forward jab glove out; 2 jab recovery retract glove; 3 heavy forearm strike preparation torso windup. Row2 4 active heavy forward forearm/backfist strike; 5 heavy recovery controlled retraction; 6 low sweep preparation bend knees and shift weight; 7 active low boot sweep forward; Row3 8 sweep recovery knees still bent; 9 hit reaction recoil back torso but intact hat/mask, looking LEFT; 10 falling KO crouch/slump with face oriented LEFT; 11 grounded KO lying lateral, complete human body knees slightly bent and face still looking LEFT. Physical normals only; no weapons, magic, flaming hands, torn limbs, enemies or trails. Grounded figure must fit in finalcell and not touch neighbor.

The native LEFT atlas supplied is only consistent material/style; generate new poses. ALL twelve human NOSES, fedora fronts, gazes, guards, jab/sweep motion point SCREEN LEFT. Mandatory cells0..11: LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT LEFT. No right-facing hit/KO or crouch. Draw independently left-facing anatomy; never reflect right-facing sheet.
